text:
violet: FYI ran into a weird combo of issues when switching sampleapp to the new Batcher.v2 helper: dims mismatch + duplicate rerank hits during auth refresh. Posting notes here.

ash: Can you paste the failing request/response?

violet: Sure, runtime error looks like:
```
RuntimeError: VectorDimensionMismatch(expected=1536, got=1280)
  at server/handlers/rerank.go:118
Request body: { vectors: [[...1280 floats...]], manifest_declared_dim: 1536 }
```

liam: That manifest_declared_dim field is written by onboarding (old build step). After switching to a 4-bit quantized model the backend now returns 1280. We should not rely on manifest_declared_dim for runtime validation.

carmen: Related: when our token expires the client refresh logic replays the exact HTTP body immediately. Batcher.v2 currently doesn't attach an idempotency header, so the rerank queue processes the batch twice in a ~200ms window. Seen by customer logs as duplicate ranking events.

ash: Which SDKs are affected? node? python? go?

carmen: All three. Batcher.v2 was ported to node/python/go but the idempotency bit was omitted on port. Also parity quirk: node helper sets a Content-MD5 header, python does not. We should align on X-Client-Batch-Id and not rely on MD5 for dedupe.

devx-bot: CI: rerank/batcher.integration failed in node 3h ago (shape mismatch + duplicate processing).

violet: Quick repro I used:
1) git checkout sampleapp@feat/batcher-v2
2) yarn && yarn dev-staging
3) POST /api/rerank with body bad_batch.json and auth header with short-lived token
bad_batch.json has 1) vectors with length 1280 and 2) manifest_declared_dim:1536
Expected: runtime rejects with clear error and not process duplicate requests when token refresh happens.

liam: Proposed fixes:
- Runtime: prefer actual body vector length for validation and return 400 with message: "vector dims mismatch: expected N based on body but manifest_declared_dim is stale". Do not accept manifest as source of truth.
- SDK batch helpers: always set header X-Client-Batch-Id = uuidv4(); attach X-Client-Batch-Schema = "batch-v2" for future changes.
- Auth flow: on 401, do async refresh + exponential backoff retry; preserve idempotency header so backend can dedupe.

ash: Example node helper change (sketch):
```js
function prepareBatch(body){
  const bodyDim = body.vectors[0].length;
  if (!body.vectors.every(v => v.length === bodyDim)) throw new Error('inconsistent vector dims');
  if (body.manifest_declared_dim && body.manifest_declared_dim !== bodyDim){
    console.warn('manifest_declared_dim != actual; ignoring manifest value');
  }
  const headers = {
    'X-Client-Batch-Id': uuidv4(),
    'X-Client-Batch-Schema': 'batch-v2'
  };
  return { body, headers };
}
```

carmen: I'll add a small migration guide: sampleapp onboarding should run `model-inspect` against deployed model and write `model_reported_dim` into the console UI (not used for runtime). That should reduce confusion for new teams.

ops-bot: Alert: one production customer saw 2x rerank events for 6 minutes due to missing idempotency header. We rolled back batcher-v2 for that customer.

liam: Tests to add: unit for inconsistent vector lengths; integration simulating token 401 then retry ensuring single server-side processing when X-Client-Batch-Id present; e2e onboarding that validates model_reported_dim equals actual produced dim post-quantization.

violet: I can open the PRs for node + python tonight; will ping go team for parity. Also will include the minimal bad_batch.json as a repro in the PR.

devx-bot: PRs created: github.com/redwood-inference/node-sdk/pulls/811, github.com/redwood-inference/python-sdk/pulls/402.

ash: Thanks — can we also add a clear error message for callers so Sentry gets searchable text like `VectorDimensionMismatch: expected 1536 per manifest but got 1280 in body` so support can triage quickly?

carmen: Yup, runtime change will include that exact phrase.

violet: tagging @support and @solutions for visibility. Will follow up after PR merges. :rocket:
